name: Om Nom Solitaire
summary:
Join Om Nom's newest adventure in a brand new genre, Tripeaks Solitaire. The latest game featuring Cut the Rope’s iconic Om Nom introduces new Solitaire gameplay, dozens of puzzles, cool boosters, and endless fun.

Om Nom Solitaire is a unique new card game where the Om Nom universe and Solitaire combine into an easy to play mobile puzzle game. Simply play one card up or one card down from your draw pile to clear the puzzle board as you take on challenging solitaire puzzles.
